text: Outsourcing valuation to an independent administrator can be nominal rather than real: the administrator may lack the understanding of complex securities products needed to value the positions, so the manager remains in charge of valuation even though the function has formally been externalized.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
